cost.scope: SHA256 over PNG bytes only; local warm/unspecified filesystem cache; elapsed wall time is approximate

geometry_overlaps.method: Pillow RGBA alpha histogram within each geometric rect intersection; no images or descriptors changed. Rect coordinates are top-left source coordinates converted by the importer to Unity bottom-left.

technical_source_review.feasible_staging_strategy: Create a new descriptor revision whose technical sourcePath points to the immutable reviewed PNG in ReviewedDeliveries, with sourceSha256 set to its actual PNG SHA and sourceSize=nativeSize. Preserve old generator path/hash in explicit provenance fields marked original-source-missing; do not call reviewed atlas the raw generator source. The importer deserializes only its known DTO fields, so extra provenance fields survive on disk but are ignored by runtime import code. Use the existing rects/pivots/PPU, after the overlap gate is resolved.
technical_source_review.limits: For 22 sheets original sourceSha256 exactly equals a reviewed atlas PNG present in staging; the other 30 unique sourceSha targets have no exact PNG content match in Assets or ArtSources. A derived descriptor cannot reconstruct those 30 raw source images or prove their generator/edit history. PAGES remains complete=false and static-reviewed; this is technical importability, not runtime/gameplay approval.

reasons: 30/52 unique upstream source hashes are not present anywhere in Assets/ArtSources; only the archived reviewed atlases/descriptors are available for derived technical source metadata.
